canonical.scope: Player attribution from direct melee and player bullet-ray geometry only.

bulletCriterionRationale.note: 64 units is the largest tested threshold before known-melee control contamination begins at 96 units.

importantLimitations: V1 does not yet attribute ability/AOE/environmental/non-player destruction.
Ambiguous bullet events are intentionally not forced to a player.
Break occurrence and reward outcome are separate variables because crates/statues do not always produce a reward.
